column1: # runtime-traits.tsv -- DGN-2180: what each dispatch pool IS, as data. lib/runtime_policy.py
# reads these columns and names no pool or vendor itself; swapping `role` between two
# accounts mirrors every pick (the policy table test does exactly that).
# pool          pool id the dispatcher uses (a runtime key)
# account       the quota account the pool draws on; pacing attaches to the ACCOUNT
#               (shared by every agent on the host), pools sharing one are one subscription
# seat          local | api (informational: which seat of the account)
# role          main = the owner's own chat model (background work spends it only while
#               under the elapsed-time pace line); background = spend freely
# reset_style   weekly | frequent | monthly (informational: how often the window refills)
# window_days   length of the paced window, days
# credit_funded 1 = paid from a credit pool that is exempt from pacing while credit
#               remains (API credit pool); the buffer rules for it
